messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I was hoping you could help me with an order I placed for my daughter. She hasn’t received it yet, and I’m a bit worried. Could you help me check which address it was sent to, the tracking number, and whether it’s still on the way? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered. And if possible, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s, so I don’t have to change it every time I order something for her.

Absolutely—I can help with all of that. First, I need to authenticate you.

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address** (preferred), or  
2) Your **first name + last name + ZIP code**

Then, to check the shipment details, please share your **order id** (it looks like `#W0000000`). If you don’t have it handy, tell me roughly when you ordered and what the tablet was (brand/model), and I’ll guide you—but the fastest is the order id.

Also, for the address update to your daughter’s, please be ready to provide:
- Address line 1
- Address line 2 (if any)
- City, State, Country
- ZIP code

I actually don’t remember my email address right now, but my name is Lucas Santos and my ZIP code is 80239.

I don’t have the order ID with me, but I placed the order about a week ago. The main thing I remember is that I ordered a tablet for my daughter—unfortunately, I can’t recall the brand or model off the top of my head. Maybe you can help me find it with my name and ZIP?

And for the address update, I’ll need to grab my daughter’s full address. Would you like me to give it to you now, or should we wait until we sort out the order details first?
